# teamrig-pane

> A Claude Code plugin that shows a session's teamrig tasks, and the files it changed in git, beside the conversation. It reads the register the teamrig CLI writes, and lists and starts the team's meetings through that CLI.

## Guide

- [teamrig-pane guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/skills/teamrig-pane-guide/SKILL.md): start here: requirements, install, the /teamrig-pane command, keys, the banner of the current task above the prompt, the Tasks view and its setup steps in a project teamrig is not set up for, its status bar, a task's card and its page with back and forward, a reference file's page, search, the archive of finished tasks a week at a time, the Changes view, each file's diff and a search of the files, the Log view of each conversation of the team's sessions, titled by its task, and a search of them, the Inbox view of the session's inbox lines, the Team view of the tree of teams the session's team is in, each session's card and a search of the sessions, the Meetings view of the team's booked meetings, each one's card and its start press, how it relates to teamrig
- [Reference](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/skills/teamrig-pane-guide/reference.md): where it finds the register, its settings, each WARN line with its fix, its limits

## Design

- [Plugin README](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig-pane/blob/main/plugins/teamrig-pane/README.md): every view, key and limit, and how the pane copies teamrig's reader

## Optional

- [teamrig guide](https://github.com/GeneralA6/teamrig/blob/main/plugins/teamrig/skills/teamrig-guide/SKILL.md): the CLI that writes the tasks and inboxes the pane shows
